I changed both partials so `required` is only set on the file input while no file is saved. I haven't run the tests or rendered the page to check it.

The edit is the same one-line change in `_generic_file_field.html.erb` and `_as_student_photo.html.erb`:

```erb
options[:required] = (configuration["required"] && !field.object.file.present?) ? true : false
```

A required field that already has a file no longer blocks the browser's form check, so saving works again. The requirement is still enforced on the server in `validate_file_field`, as the issue describes. I left the `required` CSS class on the `<li>` alone, so the field still looks required.

Because the check is `field.object.file.present?`, a file that was just uploaded but failed server validation also counts as present only if the object still holds it. I didn't look into that case, which overlaps with #604.
